read_me_first.headline: The market is in Stage 3 (Topping): the distribution phase of the cycle, 2 weeks in. SPY and QQQ are at the canon's market-top reading on distribution days.
because: Stage 3 means topping after a rise: the 30-week average has rolled flat and price is chopping around it. The last completed week closed 3.11% below the 30-week average (751.67), and that average has risen 0.37% over four weeks.
Distribution days (down closes on heavier volume) in the last 25 sessions: SPY 9, QQQ 9. O'Neil's canon reads 4 or more as a market top.
QQQ is in Stage 3 (Topping), which agrees with SPY.
Of 2271 single names on AQE's panel, 30.2% are in Stage 2 (four weeks ago 34.8%) and 39.5% are in Stage 4 (four weeks ago 31.3%): the single names agree with the index.
Sectors: Stage 2 (Advancing): XLE, XLF, XLP, XLV; Stage 3 (Topping): XLB, XLI, XLK, XLRE, XLY; Stage 4 (Declining): XLC, XLU.
read_me_first.so_what: Stage 3 is distribution: the advance has stalled and stronger hands are selling into strength. Doctrine: protect gains, tighten stops, stop adding.
watch_for: Which way SPY leaves the range around 751.67 decides the next stage.
SPY has 9 distribution days in 25 sessions, at or above the canon's top signal (4).
QQQ has 9 distribution days in 25 sessions, at or above the canon's top signal (4).
caveats: Breadth counts every single name on AQE's own weekly panel (aqe_panel_equities), not the whole US market.

source: Weinstein four-stage analysis on weekly bars (src/stages/spec.py)

distribution_days.note: any down close on heavier volume counts (the canon sets no minimum decline); stall days are not counted (the canon gives no number for 'negligible progress')
